options.name: active
options.description: Whether or not the hook is active.

options.name: content_type
options.description: The media type used to serialize the payloads.

options.name: events
options.description: A list of GitHub events the hook is triggered for. Events are listed at U(https://developer.github.com/v3/activity/events/types/). Required unless O(state=absent).

options.name: github_url
options.description: Base URL of the GitHub API.

options.name: insecure_ssl
options.description: Flag to indicate that GitHub should skip SSL verification when calling the hook.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to authenticate to GitHub with.

options.name: repository
options.description: Full name of the repository to configure a hook for.

options.name: secret
options.description: The shared secret between GitHub and the payload URL.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the hook should be present or absent.

options.name: token
options.description: Token to authenticate to GitHub with.

options.name: url
options.description: URL to which payloads are delivered.

options.name: user
options.description: User to authenticate to GitHub as.
